[255:0] chiplet_id_value rw 0x0 -

Field Descriptions

chiplet_id_value

Chiplet ID stored in fuse, divided into 8 words and defined as follows: [1:0]: Serial number of the chiplet. The format is flexible and could include time info of manufacture, (x, y) coordinates on the wafer, and a counter for example; [3]: Chiplet Design Version. The format is flexible and the word bits could be defined as reserved[31:16], major[15:8], minor[7:0] for example;[127:96]: Chiplet Design ID, e.g. Athena/Quasar/…​; [4]: Chiplet User ID. When TT assembles the package, we assign TT’s ID (32’b0); [5]: Chiplet User Group ID; [7:6]: Reserved for extension.
